prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1161; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact collision at signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a third-party vehicle that entered on a red signal, per initial statement from insured. No police report number yet on file. Insured reports neck and lower back discomfort, states she was seen at urgent care same day. Assigned to field inspection.

Entry 2: Recorded recorded statement from insured. She describes being stopped with a green light in the opposite direction when the other vehicle proceeded through the intersection. Airbag did not deploy on insured vehicle. Photos of both vehicles received and reviewed. Damage consistent with side impact described. Third-party carrier notified and liability acknowledgment requested.

Entry 3: Claimant is not represented by an attorney. Explained claims process, rental coverage options, and right to choose own repair facility. Claimant confirmed understanding and has not signed any releases. Advised that medical records and bills should be forwarded when available. Claimant reports lower back strain with limited range of motion when lifting. Diagnosis from treating provider listed as lumbar strain, with follow-up physical therapy recommended.

Entry 4: Reviewed signal timing records and witness statement from a pedestrian at the corner. Witness corroborates that the third-party vehicle did not stop for the red light. Liability estimate revised to strongly favor insured. Third-party carrier has agreed in principle to accept seventy-five percent or greater fault pending final review of police report.

Entry 5: Police report received and matches insured account of signal violation. Physical therapy authorization requested for claimant. Vehicle repair estimate completed and submitted to repair shop. Rental vehicle in place. Bodily injury claim remains open pending treatment records. Scheduled follow-up call with claimant in one week to check on recovery progress and confirm therapy attendance.
